name: Colonial District Walk
desc: The civic heart of old Singapore: grand hotels, churches and museums around the Padang.

stops.name: Raffles Hotel
stops.note: Start at the grand 1887 colonial hotel — birthplace of the Singapore Sling.

stops.name: CHIJMES
stops.note: A former 1840s convent with a Gothic chapel, now a dining enclave.

stops.name: St Andrew's Cathedral
stops.note: Singapore's largest Anglican cathedral (1862), in Neo-Gothic style.

stops.name: National Gallery Singapore
stops.note: Southeast Asian art in the former City Hall and Supreme Court.

stops.name: Asian Civilisations Museum
stops.note: Asian cultures and their historic links to Singapore, by the river.

stops.name: The Fullerton Hotel
stops.note: The neoclassical former General Post Office at the river mouth.

stops.name: Merlion Park
stops.note: Finish with the iconic Merlion and Marina Bay skyline views.

name: Chinatown Heritage Walk
desc: Temples, clan houses and legendary hawker food in historic Chinatown.

stops.name: Buddha Tooth Relic Temple
stops.note: Tang-styled temple housing a sacred tooth relic.

stops.name: Sri Mariamman Temple
stops.note: Singapore's oldest Hindu temple (1827), with a colourful gopuram.

stops.name: Maxwell Food Centre
stops.note: Home of Tian Tian Hainanese chicken rice.

stops.name: Chinatown Complex Food Centre
stops.note: The largest hawker centre, over 260 stalls.

stops.name: Thian Hock Keng Temple
stops.note: The oldest Hokkien temple (1840), dedicated to the sea goddess Mazu.

stops.name: Amoy Street Food Centre
stops.note: CBD hawker favourite with Michelin-recognised stalls.

stops.name: Lau Pa Sat
stops.note: Finish at the Victorian cast-iron market hall (1894); satay street at night.

name: Kampong Glam & Little India
desc: Malay-Arab heritage and the vibrant sights, scents and temples of Little India.

stops.name: Sultan Mosque
stops.note: The golden-domed mosque (1924), focal point of Kampong Glam.

stops.name: Kampong Glam & Haji Lane
stops.note: Indie boutiques, street art and cafes along Haji Lane.

stops.name: Malay Heritage Centre
stops.note: Malay culture and history in the former Istana Kampong Glam.

stops.name: Little India Arcade
stops.note: Spice shops, flower garlands and the buzz of Little India.

stops.name: Sri Veeramakaliamman Temple
stops.note: Historic Hindu temple dedicated to goddess Kali.

stops.name: Tekka Centre
stops.note: Bustling wet market and food centre.

stops.name: Indian Heritage Centre
stops.note: Finish with the story of Indian communities in Singapore.

name: Marina Bay Waterfront
desc: Singapore's showcase bay: iconic architecture, gardens and skyline views.

stops.name: Merlion Park
stops.note: Start at the Merlion with the bay ahead.

stops.name: Esplanade - Theatres on the Bay
stops.note: The durian-shaped performing arts centre.

stops.name: ArtScience Museum
stops.note: The lotus-shaped museum at Marina Bay Sands.

stops.name: Marina Bay Sands
stops.note: Three towers and the SkyPark observation deck.

stops.name: Gardens by the Bay
stops.note: Supertree Grove, Cloud Forest and Flower Dome.

stops.name: Marina Barrage
stops.note: Green-roof dam with kite-flying lawns and skyline views.

stops.name: Singapore Flyer
stops.note: Finish on the 165-metre observation wheel.

name: Southern Ridges
desc: A green ridge-top trail with canopy walks and panoramic views.

stops.name: Mount Faber Park
stops.note: Start at the hilltop park with cable car and harbour views.

stops.name: Henderson Waves
stops.note: Singapore's highest pedestrian bridge, 36 m up, in a wave form.

stops.name: Labrador Nature Reserve
stops.note: Finish at the coastal park with WWII fortifications and rocky shore.
